title: Debug and fix book display issue preventing catalog from rendering

requirements.summary: Add comprehensive console logging to BookCatalog component to debug why books are not displaying
acceptanceCriteria: Console logs show the catalog data being fetched from the backend
Console logs reveal whether the books array is empty or populated
Console logs show the coverImages mapping and whether image paths are correctly resolved
Any runtime errors or missing data are logged to help identify the root cause

file_operations.description: Add console.log statements to track: (1) raw catalog data returned from useGetBookCatalog, (2) the books array after filtering/processing, (3) the coverImages mapping object showing all keys and values, (4) each book's title and whether it has a matching cover image key, and (5) any errors during rendering or data access. Log at strategic points including after data fetch, before filtering, and during the map operation that renders BookCard components.

requirements.summary: Check and fix the coverImages mapping in BookCatalog component to ensure all 12 book titles exactly match the keys
acceptanceCriteria: All 12 book titles from the backend catalog have matching keys in coverImages object
Image paths correctly reference files like '/assets/generated/thriller-never-lie.dim_400x600.png'
No mismatches between book titles and image mapping keys

file_operations.description: Review and fix the coverImages object to ensure exact title matches for all 12 books. Verify that keys match backend book titles precisely (case-sensitive, no extra whitespace). Confirm all image paths point to existing generated assets: frontend/public/assets/generated/thriller-never-lie.dim_400x600.png, frontend/public/assets/generated/thriller-silent-patient.dim_400x600.png, frontend/public/assets/generated/thriller-girl-on-train.dim_400x600.png, frontend/public/assets/generated/thriller-boyfriend.dim_400x600.png, frontend/public/assets/generated/romantic-twisted-love.dim_400x600.png, frontend/public/assets/generated/romantic-love-hypothesis.dim_400x600.png, frontend/public/assets/generated/romantic-never-never.dim_400x600.png, frontend/public/assets/generated/romantic-when-i-am-with-you.dim_400x600.png, frontend/public/assets/generated/ghost-haunting-hill-house.dim_400x600.png, frontend/public/assets/generated/ghost-silent-hills.dim_400x600.png, frontend/public/assets/generated/ghost-stories-mr-james.dim_400x600.png, frontend/public/assets/generated/ghost-that-night.dim_400x600.png. Use '/assets/generated/' as the URL path prefix.

requirements.summary: Add error boundary or fallback UI to BookCatalog component that displays a helpful error message if books fail to load
acceptanceCriteria: If catalog fetch fails, a clear error message is displayed to the user
If books array is empty, a message indicates no books are available
Error UI helps identify whether the issue is with backend, frontend, or data mapping

file_operations.description: Add explicit error and empty state UI. If query.isError is true, display a user-friendly error message with details from query.error if available. If books array is empty after filtering but catalog data exists, show a message indicating no books match the search. If catalog data itself is empty, show a message that no books are available in the catalog. Include troubleshooting hints in error messages to help identify the source of the issue.

requirements.summary: Ensure SampleBooks component is correctly using the useGetBookCatalog hook and rendering all 12 books without any filters or limitations
acceptanceCriteria: SampleBooks component renders all 12 books from the catalog
Each book displays with cover image, title, author, and price
Grid layout shows all books simultaneously without pagination or filtering

file_operations.description: Add console logging similar to BookCatalog to track: (1) raw catalog data from useGetBookCatalog, (2) the mapping of book titles to cover images, and (3) any rendering issues. Verify that all 12 books are being rendered without any implicit filtering or limiting. Ensure the coverImages mapping includes all 12 book titles with correct paths to frontend/public/assets/generated/ images. Add fallback UI if no books are returned. Verify each BookCard receives the correct cover image path.
